title: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Gaussian Process Rectified Feature Cache
abstract: arXiv:2609.05981v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion Transformers have become the dominant paradigm in generative AI, but their high computational costs severely hinder real-time applications. Prediction-based feature caching is widely used to accelerate diffusion transformers; however, as the number of steps increases, the deviation between its predictions and the reference full-compute trajectory gradually grows. An intuitive idea is to use an online regression model to dynamically correct this deviation, but it faces the issue of label data being unavailable during the acceleration process. This paper presents a statistical observation that the residuals between the features of full computation steps using caching methods and reference full-compute trajectory locally exhibit a zero-mean Gaussian distribution. translated_title: 基于高斯过程校正特征缓存的扩散Transformer加速方法
translated_abstract: 扩散Transformer已成为生成式人工智能领域的主流范式，但其高昂的计算成本严重阻碍了实时应用。基于预测的特征缓存被广泛用于加速扩散Transformer；然而，随着步数的增加，其预测结果与参考全计算轨迹之间的偏差会逐渐增大。一个直观的思路是使用在线回归模型来动态校正这种偏差，但这面临着加速过程中标签数据不可获取的问题。本文提出了一项统计观察：使用缓存方法时，全计算步骤的特征与参考全计算轨迹之间的残差在局部呈现出零均值高斯分布。通过将全计算步骤的特征视为参考特征的含噪观测值，解决了数据获取难题。基于这一观察，本文提出了一种……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现缓存特征与全计算轨迹之间的残差局部服从零均值高斯分布，据此将全计算特征视为含噪观测，提出利用高斯过程在线回归动态校正特征缓存偏差的方法，在无需标签数据的情况下有效加速扩散Transformer。
en_tdlr: This paper observes that residuals between cached features and the reference full-compute trajectory locally follow a zero-mean Gaussian distribution, and by treating fully computed features as noisy observations, it proposes a Gaussian process-based online regression to rectify feature cache deviations, accelerating diffusion transformers without requiring label data.
